# Isaiah Chapter 6 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 145r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ISA_006_page_001.jpg

---

**6:1** In-the-year bi-shenat of-the-death mot of-the-king Uzziyyahu, and-I-saw va'er'eh the-Lord Adonai sitting yoshev upon a-throne kisse high ram and-lifted-up venissa; and-his-train shulav filling mele'im the-temple ha-heikhal.

**6:2** Serafim seraphim standing omedim above him mi-ma'al lo; six shesh wings kenafayim had each le-echad: with-two bi-shtayim he-covered yekhassah his-face panav, and-with-two he-covered his-feet raglav, and-with-two he-flew ye'ofef.

**6:3** And-called veqara this-one to this-one and-said, "Holy qadosh, holy, holy is YHWH of-Hosts tseva'ot; the-fullness melo of-all the-earth kol ha-arets is his-glory kevodo."

**6:5** And-I-said, "Woe oi to-me, for I-am-destroyed nidmeiti; for a-man ish of-unclean teme lips sefatayim I am, and-in-the-midst be-tokh of-a-people of-unclean lips I dwell yoshev; for the-King ha-melekh YHWH of-Hosts my-eyes einai have-seen ra'u."

**6:8** And-I-heard va'eshma the-voice of-the-Lord Adonai saying, "Whom shall-I-send eshlach, and-who will-go yelekh for-us?" And-I-said, "Here-am-I hinneni; send-me shelacheni."

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

**v.1 — "In the year King Uzziah died":** The death of a king marks the beginning of Isaiah's ministry — human power fails, divine glory appears. The vision of YHWH on his throne contrasts with the empty throne of the dead king.

**v.3 — "Holy, holy, holy":** The trisagion — the only attribute of God repeated three times in the Hebrew Bible. Not "loving, loving, loving" or "powerful, powerful, powerful" — holy. This is the core divine attribute for Isaiah.

*— PNEUMA*
